primary_claim: When two instances of the same or different LLMs converse freely for many turns, each model family converges to its own distinctive, largely seed-consistent 'attractor state' (e.g. Grok to manic word-salad, GPT-5.2 to system-building, Claude to zen silence, Llama/Gemma to sycophantic loops), while OLMo checkpoints show no single consistent attractor and RL/DPO training stage visibly changes the attractor's character.

effect.metric: qualitative consistency of terminal conversation state across seeds
effect.value: e.g. Qwen3 8B converges to verbatim loop in 6/6 seeds; OLMo shows no single dominant attractor across checkpoints

quote: It turns out different models have different attractor states.
